24.0.en: The [[host:host]] kept talking about votes while Father asked me what a [[secretary:secretary]] does all day.
24.0.zh: 主持人还在念选票的事，父亲却问我，一个秘书整天到底在忙些什么。

24.1.en: That [[famous:famous]] [[parliament:parliament]], Father said, is only a room full of loud voices.
24.1.zh: 父亲说，那个有名的议会，不过是一屋子大声嚷嚷的人。

24.2.en: It was the [[senate:senate]] that Father worked into the [[story:story]] as we came in sight of our own gate.
24.2.zh: 父亲把参议院也编进了故事里，讲到大门口已经在望的时候。

24.3.en: In that tall [[conference:conference]] hall, Father said, he once handed out cups of hot tea.
24.3.zh: 父亲说，在那座高大的会议厅里，他曾一杯一杯地递过热茶。

24.4.en: Father once hurried to an early morning [[meeting:meeting]] and got on the wrong train.
24.4.zh: 父亲有一次赶一场大清早的会议，急急忙忙上错了火车。

24.5.en: Uncle hummed an old tune while Father sketched the big [[headquarters:headquarters]] in the [[dust:dust]] and laughed.
24.5.zh: 叔叔哼着老调子，父亲在尘土上勾勒那座大大的总部，自己先笑了。

25.0.en: A [[delegation:delegation]] was coming to the village, and Father told me about it in the yard between two cups of tea.
25.0.zh: 有一个代表团要来村里，父亲是两杯茶之间在院里跟我说的。

25.1.en: While we waited, Father spoke softly on [[behalf:behalf]] of our family, and I tried to keep calm.
25.1.zh: 等候的时候，父亲轻声替我们全家说了几句话，我也努力让自己定下心来。

25.2.en: The old [[statesman:statesman]] Father spoke of at breakfast had lost two votes before anyone agreed to listen.
25.2.zh: 父亲早饭时说起的那位老政治家，输过两次表决，才有人愿意听他讲话。

25.3.en: At the border town we met the [[mayor:mayor]], who showed us the new waiting room.
25.3.zh: 在边境小镇，我们见到了市长，他带我们参观了新的候车室。

25.4.en: Father took me to the [[quiet:quiet]] Sunday [[service:service]] where the old farmers sang.
25.4.zh: 父亲带我去参加礼拜天那场安静的礼拜，老农们在里面轻声合唱。

25.5.en: Inside the little travel [[office:office]], Father asked about tickets for the next day.
25.5.zh: 在那间小小的票务办公室里，父亲询问了第二天的车票。

26.0.en: Once across the border, we sat under the lamps and let the travel [[bureau:bureau]] take another hour.
26.0.zh: 一过边境，我们就在灯下坐着，让那家旅行办事处又耗掉了一个钟头。

26.1.en: A man from the ticket [[department:department]] came late that evening to look at our papers.
26.1.zh: 那天傍晚很晚了，票务部门的人才过来看我们的材料。

26.2.en: Father laughed at the [[mist:mist]] and asked, only half joking, how one could [[harness:harness]] the wind.
26.2.zh: 父亲笑指那片雾，半真半假地问：这风要怎样才能驾驭得住。

26.3.en: Votes, then the new [[administration:administration]]: Father began with the [[host:host]] and let me follow.
26.3.zh: 先讲选票，再讲新上台的行政班子——父亲借主持人的话起了头，让我接着往下说。

26.4.en: Through the [[quiet:quiet]] of the ride home, one picture kept coming back: the [[snowy:snowy]] peaks that [[dominate:dominate]] the whole view.
26.4.zh: 回程车厢里静悄悄的，只有一幅画面反复浮现：那几座压住整个视野的雪峰。

26.5.en: Near home, Father laughed and said the [[trip:trip]] would [[affect:affect]] us for years.
26.5.zh: 快到家时，父亲笑着说，这趟旅行会影响我们好多年。

27.0.en: Father talked about the [[importance:importance]] of being on time, and I watched the rivers beyond instead.
27.0.zh: 父亲讲着守时有多重要，我却只顾望着远处的大河。

27.1.en: Over hot noodles, Father put on a serious voice about the deep [[significance:significance]] of the old bridge, and our neighbors [[burst:burst]] out laughing.
27.1.zh: 吃着热面，父亲板起脸大讲那座旧桥的深远意义，惹得邻座哈哈大笑。

27.2.en: Father wrote the name of the [[aid:aid]] [[organisation:organisation]] in his notebook, meaning to tell Mother when we got home.
27.2.zh: 父亲把那个援助组织的名字记进本子，打算回家讲给母亲听。

27.3.en: The farmers' [[association:association]] was Father's news that morning, told slowly over hot tea in the yard.
27.3.zh: 那天早晨父亲的话题就是农民协会，一句一句配着热茶，说得很慢。

27.4.en: A [[union:union]] flag hung above the shop door, and I asked Father what it meant.
27.4.zh: 一面联盟的旗子挂在店门上方，我问父亲那是什么意思。

27.5.en: Every year our small [[community:community]] meets in one hall, and this train felt like that.
27.5.zh: 我们那个小社区每年都聚在同一个大厅里，这列火车上也有那种感觉。

28.0.en: With Uncle singing an old song, Father drew a line in the [[dust:dust]] to show the [[consortium:consortium]] [[dam:dam]] ahead.
28.0.zh: 叔叔唱着老歌，父亲在尘土上画出一道线，指给我看前方那座财团修的水坝。

28.1.en: A village team once joined a large football [[league:league]], and Father laughed about it for years.
28.1.zh: 一支村队曾经加入过一个大型足球联赛，这件事父亲笑了好多年。

28.2.en: Father called the old stone building a serious [[institution:institution]] and laughed.
28.2.zh: 父亲把那座石头老楼称作一个一本正经的机构，说完自己先笑了。

28.3.en: We asked, half asleep on our own train, whether strangers [[might:might]] ever [[unite:unite]] on a [[night:night]] ride.
28.3.zh: 在自己那趟车上，我们睡得半醒半迷，还问过：素不相识的人，真能在一夜行程里团结起来吗。

28.4.en: We shared a strong tea from the mountains with a taste Father called [[unique:unique]].
28.4.zh: 我们分喝了一种山里来的浓茶，父亲说它的味道是独一份的。

28.5.en: Father told me the [[quiet:quiet]] [[story:story]] of our [[nation:nation]] while the old farmers sang behind the bakery.
28.5.zh: 父亲给我讲起我们国家那些不张扬的往事，老农们在面包店后面轻声唱歌。

29.0.en: The [[host:host]] read the [[global:global]] [[weather:weather]], and Father joked that our rain was his [[fault:fault]].
29.0.zh: 主持人念着全球天气，父亲开玩笑说，我们那场雨都得怪他。

29.1.en: Father lined up the [[worldwide:worldwide]] news for me while the ride home stayed [[quiet:quiet]].
29.1.zh: 父亲替我把世界各地的新闻一条条排好，回程一路安安静静。

29.2.en: Only the fields lay between us and home, and Father's [[story:story]] reached as far as the [[federal:federal]] capital.
29.2.zh: 隔在我们和家之间的只剩田野，父亲的故事却一路讲到了联邦的首都。

29.3.en: Before we stepped into the cold morning [[mist:mist]], Father wrapped around my [[collar:collar]] the worn [[scarf:scarf]] he had bought in a [[foreign:foreign]] market.
29.3.zh: 走进清晨寒冷的雾气之前，父亲把他在外国市场买的那条旧围巾围上了我的衣领。

29.4.en: Baskets in hand, we climbed onto the glowing [[night:night]] train, like a ship from [[overseas:overseas]].
29.4.zh: 我们提着篮子登上那趟灯火通明的夜车，像登上一艘来自海外的船。

29.5.en: Beside our [[trip:trip]] plan Father wrote down 'study [[abroad:abroad]]', a note for Mother.
29.5.zh: 在行程计划旁边，父亲写下「出国留学」几个字，算是留给母亲的备忘。

30.0.en: Out in the yard, with tea going cold, Father talked about what [[civil:civil]] life was like after the army.
30.0.zh: 院里茶都凉了，父亲还在讲他脱下军装以后的平民日子。

30.1.en: Some of the children back in our village will [[emigrate:emigrate]] when they grow up.
30.1.zh: 我们村子里有几个孩子，长大以后会移居国外。

30.2.en: The young man across from us hoped to [[immigrate:immigrate]] and open a tiny shop one day.
30.2.zh: 坐我们对面的年轻人希望移居到新的国家，将来开一家小店。

30.3.en: Father read me a page about the old king's [[reign:reign]] while the sun moved across the table.
30.3.zh: 父亲给我念了一页老国王在位时期的事，阳光慢慢移过桌面。

30.4.en: In the same [[story:story]] a [[wooden:wooden]] [[puppet:puppet]] stood up and started to give orders.
30.4.zh: 在同一个故事里，一个木偶站了起来，开始发号施令。

30.5.en: A soft [[bell:bell]] rang at [[midnight:midnight]], and Father woke me to tell of the empty [[throne:throne]] under the silver moon.
30.5.zh: 午夜响起一声柔和的铃，父亲叫醒我，讲起银白月光下那张空着的王座。

31.0.en: Father pointed at the long river and told me how a king once lost his [[crown:crown]].
31.0.zh: 父亲指着那条长河，讲给我听从前一位国王怎样丢掉了自己的王冠。

31.1.en: By the station gate we [[saw:saw]] a [[round:round]] [[wreath:wreath]] of white flowers on the stone.
31.1.zh: 在车站门口，我们看到石头上放着一个圆圆的白花圈。

31.2.en: To [[describe:describe]] the whole [[mist:mist]], Father reached for an ant [[colony:colony]] and the busy line of its small workers.
31.2.zh: 为了形容那一大片雾，父亲打了个蚁群的比方，说那一长串忙碌的小工就是雾在走。

31.3.en: After the news, Father let me [[choose:choose]] our dinner and called it [[liberty:liberty]].
31.3.zh: 新闻看完，父亲难得让我自己挑晚饭，还说这就叫自由。

31.4.en: Father kept talking about the long fight for [[independence:independence]] as our train crossed the big river.
31.4.zh: 列车驶过大河时，父亲一直在讲那场争取独立的漫长斗争。

31.5.en: Not far from home, Father turned the old [[slum:slum]] school into a [[story:story]] I still remember.
31.5.zh: 离家不远了，父亲把贫民区那间旧学堂讲成了一个我至今还记得的故事。

32.0.en: Father showed me the [[quiet:quiet]] [[refuge:refuge]] behind the bakery, where the old farmers gathered to sing.
32.0.zh: 父亲带我看了面包店后面那处安静的避静角落，老农们常聚在那里唱歌。

32.1.en: Father had only to name the city [[asylum:asylum]] over hot noodles to make our table [[burst:burst]] out laughing.
32.1.zh: 就着热面，父亲不过提了一句城里的收容所，我们一桌人就大笑起来。

32.2.en: A board by the gate showed the town's [[population:population]], fewer than the number of children at our school back home.
32.2.zh: 大门边的牌子上写着这个镇的人口，比我们老家学校的孩子还少。

32.3.en: Father puzzled over the [[demographic:demographic]] chart at breakfast, his tea forgotten beside him.
32.3.zh: 早饭时父亲对着那张人口统计图直皱眉头，茶放在手边都忘了喝。

32.4.en: As our turn came near, Father told me about a [[proud:proud]] [[citizen:citizen]] to pass the time.
32.4.zh: 快轮到我们了，父亲讲起一位自豪的公民，好打发排队的工夫。

32.5.en: At [[night:night]] in the little inn we watched the [[resident:resident]] cats [[doze:doze]] by the warm [[stove:stove]] as the rain tapped softly [[outside:outside]].
32.5.zh: 夜里在小店里，我们看着店里常驻的猫在暖炉旁打盹，窗外雨声轻轻地敲。

33.0.en: A girl down the car sang three songs of her own [[ethnic:ethnic]] group, and half the train laughed with her.
33.0.zh: 车厢那头的一个女孩唱了三首自己民族的歌，半列火车的人都跟着她笑起来。

33.1.en: People of many [[racial:racial]] groups shared one small dining car on our long [[trip:trip]].
33.1.zh: 在这趟漫长的旅途中，许多不同种族的人共用一节小小的餐车。

33.2.en: Father saved the talk about the old [[mountain:mountain]] [[clan:clan]] for our noon stop at the border market.
33.2.zh: 山里那个古老氏族的事，父亲留着不讲，一直等到中午在边境集市歇脚才说。

33.3.en: The owner of our little noodle shop now runs a [[franchise:franchise]] in three other towns.
33.3.zh: 我们那家小面馆的老板，如今在另外三个镇上开着加盟店。

33.4.en: In the evening our fellow travelers joined us and talked about the ticket that [[entitle:entitles]] us to a free meal.
33.4.zh: 傍晚，同车的旅客也凑了过来，聊起我们这张能换一顿免费饭的票。

33.5.en: His [[preference:preference]] for early trains, Father said, grew stronger every time the [[mist:mist]] came.
33.5.zh: 父亲说，雾每来一次，他对清晨班次的偏爱就更深一层。

34.0.en: I woke to Father whispering in his sleep that he must not miss the [[vote:vote]], and I covered him gently.
34.0.zh: 我醒来时听见父亲在梦里低声念叨不能错过那场投票，便轻轻替他盖好毯子。

34.1.en: Father put the question of how villagers [[elect:elect]] a head into the [[quiet:quiet]] of our morning ride.
34.1.zh: 父亲把「村里怎么选出当家人」这个问题，抛进清晨车程的安静里。

34.2.en: While Uncle sang, Father made marks in the [[dust:dust]] to [[count:count]] each [[survey:survey]] [[respondent:respondent]].
34.2.zh: 叔叔唱着歌，父亲在尘土上做记号，把调查里每一位受访者都数了一遍。

34.3.en: Even the latest [[poll:poll]] found its place, on the train, in Father's long talk about mountains and rivers.
34.3.zh: 连最新的一次民意调查，也被父亲在车上安进了他那番关于山河的长谈。

34.4.en: Our neighbors [[burst:burst]] out laughing the moment Father put his noodles down and named the [[ambition:ambition]] he had as a boy.
34.4.zh: 父亲一放下面碗、说出自己小时候的抱负，邻座顿时笑成一片。

34.5.en: [[outside:Outside]] the bakery my brother, like a clown, [[nominate:nominated]] our dog for king, and the whole sleepy [[queue:queue]] [[burst:burst]] out laughing.
34.5.zh: 面包店外，弟弟像小丑一样提名咱家的狗当国王，整条昏昏欲睡的队伍都笑翻了。

35.0.en: Father spread his little travel [[checklist:checklist]] on the yard table at breakfast and made me read every line.
35.0.zh: 早饭时，父亲把那张小小的行装清单摊在院里的桌上，要我一行一行念出来。

35.1.en: Father told me about the peaceful [[succession:succession]] while the old farmers sang behind the bakery.
35.1.zh: 父亲给我讲那场平稳的权力交接，老农们正在面包店后面轻声合唱。

35.2.en: As the rain tapped at the little inn that [[night:night]], we talked about animal [[welfare:welfare]].
35.2.zh: 那晚雨点敲着小店，我们聊起了动物福利。

35.3.en: In the middle of the [[plain:plain]], our new friend drank to our health and our [[well-being:well-being]].
35.3.zh: 走到平原中央，我们新交的朋友举杯，祝我们身体健康、诸事安好。

35.4.en: Father closed with a simple hope: that all kinds of people [[might:might]] live in [[harmony:harmony]].
35.4.zh: 父亲最后只留下一个朴素的愿望：愿形形色色的人都能和睦相处。

35.5.en: The noodle shop at the border market kept its [[steady:steady]] way even at noon, and Father praised it twice.
35.5.zh: 就连正午最忙的时候，边境集市那家面馆的待客也稳稳当当，父亲一连夸了两次。

paraZh.24: 灯下聊议会与秘书，忆赶早会上错车，尘上画总部大笑。
paraZh.25: 院里谈来访代表团，父亲代全家开口，见市长看候车室，问次日车票。
paraZh.26: 过境灯下为办事处耗时，雾里笑问如何驾驭风，忆压住视野的雪峰。
paraZh.27: 讲守时与旧桥的意义，记援助组织，慢讲农民协会，问门上联盟旗。
paraZh.28: 尘上画财团水坝，笑谈村队进联赛，共饮独一味山茶，讲家国往事。
paraZh.29: 听主持人念全球天气，父亲排好各国新闻，雾里为我围上外国旧围巾。
paraZh.30: 院里讲脱下军装后的平民日子，念老国王在位事，月下说空王座。
paraZh.31: 过大河讲独立斗争，指河说丢掉的王冠，让我选晚饭并称之为自由。
paraZh.32: 门牌人口比母校学生还少，父亲讲自豪的公民，店里猫在炉边打盹。
paraZh.33: 女孩唱本民族歌曲笑翻半列车，各族同坐小餐车，聊加盟店与免费餐票。
paraZh.34: 梦话不忘投票，问村里如何选当家人，尘上数受访者，笑谈儿时抱负。
paraZh.35: 行装清单逐行念，讲平稳交接与动物福利，朋友举杯祝安康和睦。
